name: Mattatha
title: Ancestor of Jesus in Luke's genealogy
summary: Mattatha is a person mentioned in the genealogy of Jesus Christ in Luke. He was the son of Nathan and the father of Menna. He is part of the Davidic lineage that Luke traces back from Jesus through King David's son Nathan, unlike Matthew who follows the line through Solomon.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Jesus' genealogy
keyEvents.description: Mattatha is mentioned as a link in Jesus' genealogy in the Gospel of Luke, as the son of Nathan and father of Menna.

keyEvents.title: Part of the Davidic lineage
keyEvents.description: Mattatha belongs to the Davidic lineage through King David's son Nathan, confirming Jesus' royal descent.

keyEvents.title: Connection to God's promise to David
keyEvents.description: Through Mattatha's place in the genealogy, God's promise to David that his offspring would endure forever is fulfilled, as prophesied by Nathan.

keyEvents.title: Christ's Human Ancestry
keyEvents.description: Matthan is part of the complete human lineage that Luke uses to show that Jesus is connected to all humanity, all the way back to Adam.
